analysis.campaignTitle: Westpack fejrer 73 år – Mystery Box tilbud
analysis.primaryGoal: Drive sales and increase order frequency with a limited-time 'Mystery Box' promotion for the company anniversary.
analysis.audience: Existing customers, B2B jewelry and packaging buyers
analysis.offer: Free Mystery Box on orders over 200 DKK, valid for a limited time and while supplies last.
analysis.primaryCta: Få din Mystery Box før de sidste er væk ➜

layoutPatterns: Top hero section with brand team photo
visualStyle.imageStyle: Mix of real employee photo, illustrated icons, and clean product photography with soft lighting and natural textures.

copyStyle.urgency: High—repeated references to limited quantities, disappearing gifts, countdown to campaign end.

reusablePatterns: Team or staff group photo to humanize brand
Limited-time free gift on order threshold
Multiple CTAs targeting both offer and product exploration
Product showcase grid organized by range/type
Colored section dividers for a festive tone
risks: Heavy urgency and scarcity language may disappoint if supply runs out quickly.
Free gift threshold may not appeal to smaller buyers.
Information-dense; long scroll could reduce click-through to products.

confidence.notes: Nearly all text and design elements are fully readable with only possible minor uncertainty in fine print due to resolution.
